subject: importinto: fix potential data race on sharedHandleSet (#66003)
summary: Fixes a real concurrency hazard by making `sharedHandleSet` effectively read-only during concurrent conflict collection: per-worker handle sets are merged into a temporary aggregate under a mutex, then merged into `sharedHandleSet` only after `errgroup.Wait()` completes. Also documents `BoundedHandleSet` as not goroutine-safe. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in dxf/importinto conflict-collection concurrency or metadata/state handling.
